posts.text: i would like to formally inform txdot that mercury does not actually move backwards during retrograde. it only looks that way from earth. the same is true of my car on the katy freeway at 5:40 pm
posts.caption: an optical illusion, per the astronomers and the traffic cameras

posts.text: mercury retrograde is just the universe putting you on the feeder road. you can see exactly where you meant to go. it is right there, running next to you. the only way back is a u-turn under the overpass
posts.caption: the texas u-turn is a spiritual practice

posts.text: per my records, my ez tag stopped reading the exact day mercury stationed retrograde. hctra says it's the windshield. i say the planet of communication is not speaking to the toll plaza, and frankly neither am i
posts.caption: the toll bill is also in pre shadow

posts.text: they say never break ground on a big project during mercury retrograde. i cannot confirm when txdot started on i-45, but i have driven it for years and it has not once gone direct
posts.caption: the orange barrels are in a permanent shadow period

posts.text: the city of houston and my astrologer finally agree on one rule for mercury retrograde. turn around, don't drown. it applies to flooded underpasses and to texting my ex. both are deeper than they look
posts.caption: barricades exist for a reason. so does the block button

posts.text: during mercury retrograde i only pick up for 713. 281 is a maybe. 832 goes to voicemail. 346 is a test from the universe and i will not be taking it until mercury goes direct
posts.caption: 621, i'm not even ready to discuss you

posts.text: with venus in taurus, my terms of courtship are simple. you will drive me to the buc-ee's in katy. you will not rush me past the brisket counter. you will understand that this is the date
posts.caption: venus in taurus does not do appetizers. it does brisket

posts.text: i have venus in cancer, so i love the way i love a whataburger table tent. i hold on to it, i take it home without asking, and twelve years later it is still on my nightstand
posts.caption: number 47 and i are in a committed relationship

posts.text: venus retrograde is when exes resurface, which is why i'm skipping the breakfast klub this weekend. that line goes around the parking lot. there is nowhere to hide, and everyone i've ever dated is ordering wings and waffles
posts.caption: exes come back in retrograde. so does my craving for grits

posts.text: my astrologer says his mars conjunct my venus means intense passion. in practice it means he insists on taking 59 when i clearly said 288, and we have not spoken since pearland
posts.caption: mars rules arguments. txdot rules everything else

posts.text: my sun is in leo, my moon is in cancer and my rising sign is houston humidity in july. you will feel me before you see me, and you will need to change your shirt
posts.caption: first impressions, measured in dew point

posts.text: my big three: sun in the heights, moon in montrose, rising in katy. people meet me and assume i have a three-car garage. emotionally i'm at an open mic on westheimer
posts.caption: the rising sign is the cul-de-sac. the moon is the poetry

posts.text: my moon is in taurus, which means i process emotions at roughly the tempo of a dj screw tape. slow, deliberate, a little chopped. please give me until the second verse to tell you how i feel
posts.caption: feelings, but slowed down so they can fully arrive

posts.text: my astrologer said not to start anything while the moon is void of course, so i've been sitting in the h-e-b parking lot on buffalo speedway for forty minutes. technically, i have not started shopping
posts.caption: the parking lot was always going to take forty minutes

posts.text: the full moon is when everything hidden comes to light, which explains the line at the 24-hour whataburger at 2 am. nobody there is hungry. we are simply illuminated
posts.caption: the moon is full and so is the drive thru

posts.text: eclipses bring sudden name changes you never agreed to. i called it minute maid park for twenty years and one january it became daikin park. i'm not saying it was eclipse season. i'm saying i was not consulted
posts.caption: it's still minute maid in my natal chart

posts.text: my saturn return hit at twenty-nine and the first symptom was buying a house in pearland. the second was explaining the drainage ditch to my friends at brunch with real enthusiasm. saturn rules structure and, apparently, gutters
posts.caption: saturn said grow up and check the flood map

posts.text: an accurate birth chart needs an exact birth time. my mother says i was born right after the traffic on 59 let up, which in houston could be any hour between 1994 and today
posts.caption: my ascendant is pending, like the southwest freeway

posts.text: the actual apollo 13 line was 'houston, we've had a problem here.' past tense. calm. already handling it. that is the energy i bring to mercury retrograde, right before i call someone in clear lake
posts.caption: mission control has better boundaries than i do

posts.text: when apollo 11 landed, armstrong's big announcement started with 'houston,' not 'moon.' the moon rules feelings, and it has been quietly sensitive about coming second in that sentence since 1969
posts.caption: tranquility base here. emotional base, slightly bruised

posts.text: i would like johnson space center to staff a console for my mercury retrograde. one flight director, three engineers and a man named gary whose only job is to say 'negative' every time i reach for my phone
posts.caption: go or no go on that text. no go

posts.text: i took the tram tour at space center houston to see the restored apollo mission control and asked which console tracked mercury retrograde. the guide said none. respectfully, that explains a lot about the sixties
posts.caption: they had slide rules and no ephemeris. bold

posts.text: houston's only official nickname is space city, which is why dating here is hard. the astronauts know exactly where mercury is. i know whether it's retrograde. neither of us can find parking in montrose
posts.caption: science and astrology, united by the valet stand

posts.text: nasa engineers in houston can predict where a spacecraft will be months from now. i can use an ephemeris to predict exactly when venus goes direct. we are both scientists. only one of us gets past the gate on nasa parkway
posts.caption: same math, different security clearance
